lines: This plan covers 2 days, starting today.
You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Lubna eats.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Zesty Quinoa and Lentil Glow
dishes.title: Red lentil stew with quinoa and rainbow vegetables
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil and quinoa portions in a pan with a splash of water. Stir in the rainbow vegetables and fresh spinach until wilted. Finish with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: A light but filling lunch that combines plant-based protein with vibrant, loud vegetables.

dishes.name: Savory Chicken and Rainbow Medley
dishes.title: Pan-seared chicken with quinoa and sautéed vegetables
dishes.method: Warm the chicken, quinoa, and vegetables in a pan. Toss with fresh spinach until the greens are just soft.
dishes.why: A high-protein, gluten-free meal designed specifically for Roxane's midday energy needs.

dishes.name: Golden Lentil Comfort Pot
dishes.title: Warm spiced lentils with quinoa and broccoli
dishes.method: Reheat the lentil stew and quinoa together until piping hot. Stir through the rainbow vegetables and serve warm.
dishes.why: A comforting, warm vegan dinner that satisfies the need for something hearty after a long day.

dishes.name: Thyme Chicken and Garden Quinoa
dishes.title: Herbed chicken with quinoa and bright vegetables
dishes.method: Heat the chicken and quinoa portions in a pan. Add the vegetables and a splash of water to keep it moist while warming.
dishes.why: A warm, structured meal for Roxane that prioritises her vegetable intake first.

dishes.name: Spiced Lentil and Quinoa Warmth
dishes.title: Coconut lentils over quinoa with rainbow veg
dishes.method: Combine the lentil, quinoa, and vegetable portions in a bowl and microwave or pan-heat until warm. Top with fresh coriander.
dishes.why: A simple, reheating-friendly lunch that stays moist thanks to the coconut lentil base.

dishes.name: Chicken and Quinoa Garden Bowl
dishes.title: Lemon chicken with quinoa and sautéed broccoli
dishes.method: Warm the chicken and quinoa. Toss with the vegetables and a dash of lemon to brighten the flavours for lunch.
dishes.why: A quick, warm lunch for Roxane that avoids gluten and fits her portioning needs.

dishes.name: Warm Sunset Grain Salad
dishes.title: Tossed lentils, quinoa and peppers
dishes.method: Pan-fry the quinoa and vegetables for 2 minutes to get them hot, then stir in the lentils to create a thick, warm salad.
dishes.why: Osric insists on a warm element for dinner; pan-warming the grains provides texture and heat.

dishes.name: Herbed Chicken and Quinoa Sauté
dishes.title: Warm chicken and quinoa with rainbow vegetables
dishes.method: Heat a teaspoon of oil in a pan. Sauté the chicken, quinoa, and vegetables together until hot and slightly toasted.
dishes.why: A warm, comforting dinner for Roxane that is entirely gluten-free.

preparations.title: Spiced Coconut Red Lentils
preparations.method: Rinse lentils. Combine with water, coconut milk, and spices in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until soft and thick.

preparations.title: Pan-Fried Thyme Chicken Strips
preparations.method: Slice chicken into strips. Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Season with thyme and salt. Fry chicken in batches until golden and cooked through.

preparations.title: Steamed Herbed Quinoa
preparations.method: Rinse quinoa thoroughly. Bring water to a boil in a pot, add quinoa, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and fluff with a fork.

preparations.title: Sautéed Rainbow Vegetables
preparations.method: Chop broccoli into florets, peppers into strips, and courgettes into half-moons. Heat oil in a large pan and sauté all vegetables until tender-crisp.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the quinoa and lentils simmering in separate pots. While they cook, chop the chicken and all vegetables. Sauté the vegetables in a large pan, remove, then fry the chicken strips in the same pan. Once everything is done, portion into the named boxes immediately.
